description: Ministry of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine - The National Medicines Regulatory Authority (Ceiling on Prices) Regulations No. 2 of 2016
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Health under the National Medicines Regulatory Authority Act, establishing price ceilings for specific medicinal products. It creates new regulatory requirements for manufacturers, importers, traders, and pharmacists regarding drug pricing, labeling, and compliance. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it establishes binding regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements rather than focusing on government personnel changes or other specialized categories.
